note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors; nominations were received on 20 April 1927 and Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 1 June 1927. Two candidates were nominated for each of Fallagh, Fintona and Seskinore (Ulster Herald, 23 April 1927, p. 5); by 30 April the Fallagh and Fintona oppositions had been withdrawn, leaving Seskinore the only contest (Ulster Herald, 30 April 1927, p. 5: 'Thirteen Nationalists have therefore been returned unopposed to the Rural Council, as compared with twenty Unionists'). In Fintona Mr. Philip M'Caffrey, P.E.T., 'has got a walk-over', Mr. George Fleming (Unionist) having withdrawn his nomination (Ulster Herald, 30 April 1927, p. 5). Labels as printed in the nomination list. Returned unopposed.
